_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Prehistoric Senegal and Senegambian Stone Circles
910.label: Event
910.description: Megaliths of the Senegambia; shell middens; early agricultural and fishing communities along the Senegal and Gambia rivers.

910.name: Senegambian Stone Circles (UNESCO)
910.label: Event
910.description: Over 1,000 megalithic laterite stone circles at Sine Ngayène and Wanar; funerary monuments spanning nearly two millennia.

910.name: Early Settlement and Iron Age Communities
910.label: Event
910.description: Shell middens on the coast; iron smelting; fishing and agriculture along Senegal River; foundation for later states.

920.name: Jolof Confederation and Wolof States
920.label: Event
920.description: Ndiadiane Ndiaye founds the Jolof Empire; confederation of Wolof, Serer, and other states; trans-Saharan connections.

920.name: Jolof Empire and Confederation
920.label: Event
920.description: Jolof unites Cayor, Baol, Waalo, Sine, Saloum under Bourba Jolof; caste system; Wolof political culture.

920.name: Battle of Danki and Breakup of Jolof
920.label: Event
920.description: Cayor defeats Jolof at Battle of Danki 1549; Wolof states become independent; Atlantic trade reorients power to coast.

930.name: Atlantic Trade and Gorée Island
930.label: Event
930.description: Portuguese, Dutch, French, and British compete for Senegambian trade; Gorée as slave trade hub; gum arabic trade on the Senegal River.

930.name: Gorée Island and the Slave Trade
930.label: Event
930.description: Gorée Island as European slave trading depot; Maison des Esclaves; symbol of the Atlantic slave trade (UNESCO).

930.name: Signares and Métis Society
930.label: Event
930.description: Powerful Afro-European women (signares) dominate Saint-Louis and Gorée commerce; hybrid Franco-African culture.

940.name: French Colonisation of Senegal
940.label: Event
940.description: Faidherbe's expansion; Four Communes citizenship; AOF capital Dakar; groundnut economy; Islamic brotherhoods.

940.name: Faidherbe's Expansion and Conquest
940.label: Event
940.description: Governor Faidherbe expands from Saint-Louis; subjugates Toucouleur and Wolof states; railway built.

940.name: Four Communes and African Citizenship
940.label: Event
940.description: Saint-Louis, Gorée, Rufisque, Dakar grant French citizenship to African originaires; Blaise Diagne elected 1914.

950.name: Independence and Léopold Sédar Senghor Era
950.label: Event
950.description: Senghor's négritude philosophy; Mali Federation; independence 1960; single-party to multiparty transition.

950.name: Négritude and Senghor's Intellectual Legacy
950.label: Event
950.description: Senghor co-founds négritude with Aimé Césaire; celebrates Black identity; poet-president model.

950.name: Independence of Senegal
950.label: Event
950.description: Senegal independent 4 April 1960 after Mali Federation collapse; Senghor first president.

950.name: Abdou Diouf Era
950.label: Event
950.description: Diouf succeeds Senghor; full multiparty democracy; Casamance conflict; economic liberalisation; Sopi movement.

950.name: Casamance Separatist Conflict
950.label: Event
950.description: MFDC rebellion in Casamance; ethnic Diola grievances; low-intensity conflict; intermittent peace talks.

950.name: Diouf's Democratic Opening
950.label: Event
950.description: Full multiparty politics; structural adjustment; 1988 election crisis; gradual liberalisation; defeated 2000.

960.name: Contemporary Senegal
960.label: Event
960.description: Alternance démocratique; Wade and Sall presidencies; democratic consolidation; economic ambitions; 2024 political crisis.

960.name: Abdoulaye Wade Presidency
960.label: Event
960.description: Wade wins historic 2000 alternance; African Renaissance Monument; third-term controversy; defeated 2012.

960.name: Macky Sall Presidency
960.label: Event
960.description: Sall wins 2012; infrastructure development; oil and gas discoveries; 2024 political crisis over Sonko's candidacy.
